title: Gotta Eat!
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Why do all living things need to eat? Sabrina explores what organisms eat to get energy and how plants, animals, and people fit into the big picture of life on Earth.

title: Here Comes the Sun
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Sabrina explains what the Sun is, how it works, and how its energy travels 93 million miles to reach us and power almost all life on Earth.

title: Fabulous Food Chains
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Sabrina breaks down how energy moves through an ecosystem — from the Sun to plants to animals — and why every link in a food chain matters.

title: Defining Gravity
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: What is gravity, and why does everything fall down? Sabrina explains the invisible force that holds the universe together — from falling apples to orbiting planets.

title: Weathering and Erosion
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: How do rivers carve canyons and rain wear down mountains? Sabrina explores weathering and erosion — the slow, powerful forces that reshape the surface of our planet.

title: The Science of Lunch
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: What actually happens when you eat your lunch? Sabrina investigates the science behind food — from where ingredients come from to how your body uses energy.

title: Home Sweet Habitat
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: What makes a habitat perfect for an animal? Sabrina explores the five things every habitat must provide — air, water, food, shelter, and space — and why animals need specific environments to survive.

title: Food Webs
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Sabrina shows how food chains connect to create food webs — complex networks of who eats whom — and what happens to an ecosystem when one piece is removed.

title: Everything Revolves Around You
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Why does the Moon orbit the Earth? Why does the Earth orbit the Sun? Sabrina explains orbits, gravity, and why planets and moons don't just fly off into space.

title: Dinosaur Pee? — The Water Cycle
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Did you know the water you drink might once have been dinosaur pee? Sabrina explains the water cycle — how Earth's water is constantly recycled through evaporation, clouds, and rain.

title: Climate Change
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: Sabrina explains what climate change is, why it's happening, and what it means for ecosystems and living things around the world — including us.

title: Living Things Change
speaker: Crash Course Kids
description: How do animals adapt when their environment changes? Sabrina explores how living things evolve and change over time — from polar bears to tiny bacteria.

title: Every Kind of Volcano
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Jessi and friends explore the different types of volcanoes — from shield volcanoes that ooze lava slowly to cinder cones that explode dramatically. Why do some erupt gently and others violently?

title: Busy Bees! Bumblebees and Honeybees
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Jessi and Squeaks investigate bees — what makes bumblebees and honeybees different, how they make honey, why they're so important for plants, and how to spot them in the wild.

title: Don't Be Afraid of Spiders!
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Jessi makes the case that spiders are amazing, not scary — explaining how they spin silk, catch prey, and play a vital role in keeping insect populations under control.

title: The Amazing Adaptations of Cave Animals!
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Deep in caves with no light, strange animals have evolved incredible abilities. Jessi explores cave fish with no eyes, glowing worms, and other weird creatures that have adapted to life underground.

title: Diamond, the Super Crystal!
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Why are diamonds so hard? Jessi explains how carbon atoms arrange themselves under extreme heat and pressure deep underground — and why the same material that makes diamonds also makes pencil lead.

title: What's Inside These Rocks?
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Jessi and Squeaks crack open some rocks and discover the crystals, fossils, and minerals hidden inside — explaining how different types of rocks form over millions of years.

title: What Are Stalactites and Stalagmites?
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: How do those giant rock spikes grow inside caves? Jessi explores how water slowly builds stalactites and stalagmites drop by drop over thousands of years — and why caves are basically living, growing places.

title: Antarctica: The Coldest Place on Earth!
speaker: SciShow Kids
description: Jessi visits the world's coldest, windiest, and most remote continent — discovering the penguins, seals, and microorganisms that survive in Antarctica's extreme environment.
